title: _parse_jsonish silently swallows JSONDecodeError and returns None
description: paper-v2 4-layer audit §6.BUG-AUDIT-003 found backend/services/strategy_package/service.py:264-275 _parse_jsonish silently returns None on malformed JSON without logging or raising. Violates user global feedback_no_silent_errors rule. Caller (_qe_source_payload) treats result as empty metrics dict → corrupted experiment silently displays zero metrics in QE-packaging-sources picker. Codex fix (commit 1462099) adds bounded warning log with snippet on malformed JSON.

preconditions: qe_experiments.result_metrics row contains malformed JSON string
